priorityList: Cast Arcane Intellect before combat begins.
Pre-cast Glacial Spike or Frostbolt immediately before the pull.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost to maximize burst windows.
Cast Comet Storm if the Splinterstorm buff is not active on you.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active, unless the Thermal Void buff is currently active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate resources and splinters.
Cast Ice Lance if you have the Fingers of Frost proc active.
Cast Glacial Spike whenever it is available (at 5 Icicles).
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing (Winter's Chill) debuff.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Flurry if charges are available to apply Winter's Chill to the target.
If forced to move, use Blink to maintain casting; otherwise, use Ice Nova, Cone of Cold, or Ice Lance.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
